insurer: Vistar Shield General Insurance Co. Ltd.
reasonText: The room rent limit under your policy is 1% of the sum insured per day, i.e. Rs 5,000/- per day. You occupied a Deluxe room charged at Rs 9,000/- per day. As the room chosen is costlier than the entitled room, the insurer has applied a proportionate deduction of 4/9 (44.44%) on room-rent-linked charges such as surgeon, anaesthetist, OT and nursing charges. The amount of Rs 1,64,600/- is admitted against the claimed amount of Rs 2,48,600/-.
